integrity: One-step mathematical classification; historical indefinite Lyapunov approximations, best-rank SVD and positive-part repair are established ingredients. Results have received a self-review only, with independent publication priority and scientific validation outstanding.
scientific_limitations: One exact projected exponential Euler step with constant positive-semidefinite forcing and scalar Lyapunov drift; sharp transition on an explicit rank-two positive initial state. No general noncommuting drift or long-time invariant-preservation theorem. Numerical corroboration supplements analytical proof.
title: Rank-one immunity and a sharp rank-two positivity transition in projected exponential Lyapunov integration
